name: Injoku Iin
source:
A practical insult game with pregnant women and nurses as targets. There are three sizes of stomach to choose from.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
這是一款以孕婦和護士為目標的實用取向的凌辱遊戲。你可以選擇三種不同的肚子大小。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]］
